/* userLogin_backup_2 - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT C.USER_ID, C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(C.USER_ID) AS FLNM_ENCPT,
/* G.INST_NM, H.ENG_CTPV_NM, H.CTPV_NM, G.RGN_CD, H.SGG_NM, */
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.BRTH_YMD WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.BRTH_YMD ELSE '' END AS BIRTHDATE,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.SXDC_SE_CD WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.SXDC_SE_CD ELSE '' END AS GENDER,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.EML_ADDR_ENCPT WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.EML_ADDR_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS EMAIL,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT ELSE '' END AS MOBILE,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(D.BRTH_YMD, 1, 4)) + 1) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(F.BRTH_YMD, 1, 4)) + 1) ELSE '' END AS AGE,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '종사자' WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '기관' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL AND YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'Y' THEN '청소년' WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL AND YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'G' THEN '보호자' ELSE '' END AS MEMBER_TYPE,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (
SELECT N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM || '/' || M.INST_NM || '/' || M.INST_NO || '/' || M.INST_TYPE_SE_CD || '/' || M.RPRS_TELNO FROM SCA100 K /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAC100 N /* 공통코드 값 */ ON N.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = K.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAA000 M /* 통합기관 */ ON M.INST_NO = K.OGDP_INST_NO WHERE K.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO
) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.RPRS_TELNO WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '' ELSE '' END AS AGENCY_CONTACTS,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.OGDP_INST_NO WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C.INST_NO ELSE 0 END AS INST_NO,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT V.INST_NM FROM SAA000 V /* 통합기관 */ WHERE V.INST_NO = D.OGDP_INST_NO) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT V.INST_NM FROM SAA000 V /* 통합기관 */ WHERE V.INST_NO = C.INST_NO) ELSE '' END AS INST_NM,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (
SELECT N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SCA100 K /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAC100 N /* 공통코드 값 */ ON N.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = K.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD WHERE K.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO
) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (
SELECT N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAA000 K /* 통합기관 */ LEFT JOIN SAC100 N /* 공통코드 값 */ ON N.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = K.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD WHERE K.INST_NO = C.INST_NO
) ELSE '' END AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (
SELECT M.MENU_NO FROM SCA100 K /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAC100 N /* 공통코드 값 */ ON N.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = K.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAB200 M /* 메뉴 */ ON M.MENU_NM = N.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AND M.MENU_LEVELA_NO = 1 WHERE K.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO
) ELSE 0 END AS TOP_MENU_NO,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT G.RGN_CD FROM SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = D.OGDP_INST_NO ) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.RGN_CD WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '' ELSE '' END AS RGN_CD,
( /* SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(O.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM SAB930 O / 접속로그 / WHERE O.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID AND O.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = 'I' */ '' ) AS LAST_LOGIN_TIME,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C.ENFSN_NO ELSE '' END AS ENFSN_NO,
CASE WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C.INST_NO ELSE 0 END AS USER_INST_NO,
CASE WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO ELSE '' END AS YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO,
CASE WHEN C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO ELSE '' END AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD ELSE '' END AS ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT H.INST_TYPE_SE_CD FROM SCA100 G /* 종사자 */ LEFT JOIN SAA000 H /* 통합기관 */ ON H.INST_NO = G.OGDP_INST_NO WHERE G.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO ) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.INST_TYPE_SE_CD ELSE '' END AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.WRD_TELNO WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN E.RPRS_TELNO WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN F.WRD_TELNO ELSE '' END AS WRD_TELNO,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN G.PST_ADDR IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(G.PST_ADDR, 1, INSTR(G.PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END FROM SCA300 G /* 개인정보 */ WHERE G.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN E.BPLC_PST_ADDR IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, 1, INSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN F.PST_ADDR IS NULL THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(F.PST_ADDR, 1, INSTR(F.PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END ELSE '' END AS SIDO_NM,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN G.PST_ADDR IS NULL OR SUBSTR(G.PST_ADDR, 1, 2) = '세종' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(G.PST_ADDR, INSTR(G.PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1, INSTR(G.PST_ADDR, ' ', INSTR(G.PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1) - INSTR(G.PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END FROM SCA300 G /* 개인정보 */ WHERE G.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO) WHEN C.INST_NO IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN E.BPLC_PST_ADDR IS NULL OR SUBSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, 1, 2) = '세종' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, INSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1, INSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, ' ', INSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1) - INSTR(E.BPLC_PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END WHEN C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN F.PST_ADDR IS NULL OR SUBSTR(F.PST_ADDR, 1, 2) = '세종' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(F.PST_ADDR, INSTR(F.PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1, INSTR(F.PST_ADDR, ' ', INSTR(F.PST_ADDR, ' ') + 1) - INSTR(F.PST_ADDR, ' ') - 1) END ELSE '' END AS SIGUNGU_NM,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN D.OGDP_DEPT_CD ELSE '' END AS DEPT_CD,
CASE WHEN C.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT G.DEPT_NM FROM SAA300 G /* 기관부서 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = D.OGDP_INST_NO AND G.DEPT_CD = D.OGDP_DEPT_CD) ELSE '' END AS DEPT_NM,
C.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD /* 그룹권한구분코드 */
FROM SAA200 C /* 사용자 */
LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 E /* 통합기관 */ ON E.INST_NO = C.INST_NO LEFT JOIN SCA200 F /* 청소년학부모 */ ON F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
WHERE C.USER_ID = #{id}
AND C.USER_PSWD_ENCPT = #{pass}
AND C.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = '2' /* 승인 상태만 로그인 허용 */ AND NVL(C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN, 'N') != 'Y' /* 차단 해제 상태만 로그인 허용 */

/* findIdEmail - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT USER_ID
FROM SAA200 C /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO /* LEFT JOIN SAA000 E 통합기관 ON E.INST_NO = C.INST_NO */ LEFT JOIN SCA200 F /* 청소년보호자 */ ON F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
WHERE ( (D.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{name}) AND D.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{email})) OR (F.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{name}) AND F.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{email})) ) AND (C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN IS NULL OR C.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN = 'N') AND C.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD IN ('1', '2')

/* selectUserIdCount - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM SAA200 C /* 사용자 */
LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO /* LEFT JOIN SAA000 E 통합기관 ON E.INST_NO = C.INST_NO */ LEFT JOIN SCA200 F /* 청소년보호자 */ ON F.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = C.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND (USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN IS NULL OR USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN = 'N') AND USER_ID_USE_SE_CD IN ('1', '2')
AND ( (D.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{nameEncpt}) AND D.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emailEncpt}))
OR (F.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{nameEncpt}) AND F.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{emailEncpt})) )
AND ( (D.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{nameEncpt}) AND ( D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{phone1}) OR D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{phone2}) ) )
OR (F.FLNM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{nameEncpt}) AND ( F.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{phone1}) OR F.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{phone2}) ) ) )
AND 1 = 2
